ai/npc/Teleports/Survivor/32632-1.htm.text: Gracia Survivor: There is a place at the western end of Aden, on the shores of the Sea of Gludio, where airships depart for Gracia. links.text: Move to Gludio Airship Wharf (150,000 Adena).

ai/npc/Teleports/Survivor/32632-2.htm.text: Gracia Survivor: I understand. But as I told you earlier, if you're short of money, you can still get to Gracia through another route. Visit the gatekeeper in Gludio Castle Village or Talking Island, and they can send you to the Airship Wharf. I hope you will do so. We can use everyone we can!

ai/npc/Teleports/Survivor/32632-3.htm.text: Gracia Survivor: I understand. But Gracia is not a place to be taken lightly. Given your inexperience, even if you go there you would only be a liability to the effort. Aden also has many monsters and the need for adventurers to fight them.
